coast.source: Natural Earth 1:50m land and lakes, via Terra's Globe/geo.png
coast.what: signed distance to the coast, fine in L (128 + 8 d, |d| <= 16 px) and coarse in A (128 + d / 2), land positive

currents.credit: This study used data collected and made freely available by the NOAA Global Drifter Program (https://www.aoml.noaa.gov/phod/gdp/) accessed from https://erddap.aoml.noaa.gov/gdp/erddap/index.html
currents.source: NOAA GDP drifter climatology v3.10 monthly means (Laurindo, Mariano and Lumpkin 2017), CC BY 4.0
currents.what: the month's mean near-surface current, eastward in R, northward in G, how measured in B

eddy.credit: This study used data collected and made freely available by the NOAA Global Drifter Program (https://www.aoml.noaa.gov/phod/gdp/) accessed from https://erddap.aoml.noaa.gov/gdp/erddap/index.html
eddy.source: NOAA GDP current variance (Laurindo, Mariano and Lumpkin 2017) times the Lagrangian integral time scale measured from GDP 6-hourly trajectories 2016-2023
eddy.step: a Gaussian step of standard deviation sqrt(2 K dt) metres on each axis
eddy.what: lateral eddy diffusivity, zonal in R and meridional in G, how measured in B

ice.credit: Fetterer, F., K. Knowles, W. N. Meier, M. Savoie and A. K. Windnagel. Sea Ice Index, Version 4. NSIDC
ice.source: NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4, monthly means 2015-2024, via Terra's Globe/ground/ice-MM.png
ice.what: the month's usual sea-ice concentration, 255 all ice

stream.credit: This study used data collected and made freely available by the NOAA Global Drifter Program (https://www.aoml.noaa.gov/phod/gdp/) accessed from https://erddap.aoml.noaa.gov/gdp/erddap/index.html
stream.source: solved from the currents sheet by tools/ocean/build.py
stream.unit: m/s radians on the unit sphere
stream.what: the month's stream function, sixteen bits (R high, G low)

wind.credit: NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1 data provided by the NOAA PSL, Boulder, Colorado, USA
wind.source: NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1, long-term monthly means 1991-2020 (NOAA PSL)
wind.what: the month's mean 10 m wind, eastward in R and northward in G
